submission.justification: Selection-S1 has the highest statistical-only significance (~4.3σ at 50%), but its background estimate is not robust: the validation region shows a 35% data/MC yield disagreement, caused by poorly modelled jet-substructure inputs. The agreed tolerance is 10%, so S1 is ruled out. S2 (6% disagreement) and S3 (3%) both pass. S2 has clearly higher significance than S3 (about 3.2–3.4σ vs about 2.35–2.55σ). The S2 scan from 30% to 70% efficiency is nearly flat, and Monte Carlo noise is about ±0.1σ: two runs at 50% gave 3.41σ and 3.27σ. 50% has the highest average among the points scanned, and it matches the 2025 summary (3.4σ). The 55% point (3.36σ) is statistically equivalent. Caveats: all significances are statistical only, so systematics will lower them. S2's 6% mismodelling is within tolerance but should be included as a background systematic.

requirements.evidence: Among strategies that meet the robustness constraint, S2 is highest: about 3.3–3.4σ at 50% vs S3 about 2.5σ. S1 (about 4.3σ) is excluded by the robustness constraint. Values are statistical only.
